init.title: Game Event Actions
init.description: Run any Home Assistant actions when game events occur. Each event also fires on the event bus (e.g. nba_live_scoreboard_team_scored). In these action sequences, payload fields are top-level template variables such as team_score, opponent_name, and scoring_play_text. In an event-triggered automation, use trigger.event.data.team_score instead.
